title: Smaller Models, Better Rejects: Preference Distillation Scaling
abstract: arXiv:2609.38987v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Preference distillation typically treats a teacher response as preferred and the student's own response as rejected. This assumes that self-generated failures are the most informative negatives and that rejects must come from a model at least as large as the student, making generation costly at scale. We find neither assumption holds: across students from 7B to 72B, smaller frozen models generate rejects with less inference compute yet train stronger students than self-generated rejects, before and after sequence-level knowledge distillation, on code generation and mathematical reasoning. To explain this result, we derive a finite-horizon utility bound for Direct Preference Optimization in a linearized feature model. The bound characterizes favorable reject distributions and motivates three interventions. translated_title: 更小的模型，更好的拒绝样本：偏好蒸馏的规模化研究
translated_abstract: 偏好蒸馏通常将教师模型的回复视为偏好样本，而将学生模型自己生成的回复视为拒绝样本。这隐含了两个假设：自我生成的失败是最具信息量的负样本，且拒绝样本必须来自至少与学生模型规模相当（或更大）的模型，这使得大规模生成的成本很高。我们发现这两个假设都不成立：在7B到72B的学生模型上，更小的冻结模型能以更少的推理计算量生成拒绝样本，却在代码生成和数学推理任务上训练出比使用自我生成拒绝样本更强的学生模型，无论在序列级知识蒸馏之前还是之后都是如此。为了解释这一结果，我们在线性化特征模型中推导了直接偏好优化（DPO）的有限时域效用界。该界刻画了有利的拒绝样本分布，并启发了三种干预措施。第一，混合来自更小模型和学生模型规模的拒绝样本，随着更小模型所占份额的增加，性能会得到提升。第二，重新……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文发现，比学生模型更小的冻结模型能以更少的推理计算生成更有效的拒绝样本，从而在偏好蒸馏中训练出更强的学生模型，并通过理论效用界刻画了有利拒绝样本分布的特征。
en_tdlr: Smaller frozen models generate cheaper and more effective rejects than self-generated ones for preference distillation across student scales from 7B to 72B, with a theoretical utility bound characterizing favorable reject distributions.
